source.author: pcvetkovski
source.text:
We are open-sourcing an earlier version of Finsight, based on Qwen3-14B, adapted for financial reasoning.

One interesting result was the trade-off: - FinQA accuracy improved from 1.9% to 12.6% - Six-benchmark average declined from 0.441 to 0.399

Finsight is the personal financial analyst powering Maxint, the financial OS.

The model, checkpoints and training methodology are made available for anyone to reproduce and build on the work.

These are experimental models and we do not consider the results and evidence of production readiness for financial applications.

Source: https://maxint.com/blog/open-sourcing-finsight-qwen3-14b
source.title: Open-sourcing Finsight, based on Qwen3-14B for financial reasoning
